_about: Rival tycoons (rt3-clone-spec section 13). Names are historical figures named as RT3 opponents [D/C] or famous railroad builders; bios are our own. Personality numbers run 0-100 and are [I]; speculation from 70 sells short, takeovers from 50 builds stakes and bids for control; industry from 40 buys and upgrades industries its lines serve; recession_caution holds back building, borrowing and dividends in recessions (doubled in depressions).

tycoons.name: Cecil Rhodes
tycoons.bio: Wants a line across every map he sees, and rarely stops to count the cost.

tycoons.name: Jay Gould
tycoons.bio: Builds what he must, but his real railroad is the stock exchange.

tycoons.name: J. P. Morgan
tycoons.bio: Prefers sound money, steady dividends and buying up whoever overreaches.

tycoons.name: William Wheelwright
tycoons.bio: A patient builder of long lines through hard country.

tycoons.name: Kodama Gentaro
tycoons.bio: Methodical and cautious; expands only when the books allow.

tycoons.name: James J. Hill
tycoons.bio: Builds cheaply, runs efficiently, and lets profits pay for the next line.

tycoons.name: Leland Stanford
tycoons.bio: Borrows freely to build fast, trusting traffic to follow the rails.
